end.summary:
Discussed how festivals vary across regions and may be celebrated in different ways.
Kavya gave Diwali examples: sweets, lamps, and rangoli.
Identified Onam as a festival from Kerala and distinguished it from Punjab.
Practised linking harvest festivals with farming seasons; teach-back was not completed.
Kavya asked whether festival dates depend on seasons; this was not resolved in the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised regional festival examples and used Kavya’s Diwali observations to discuss different celebrations. Kavya correctly connected Onam with Kerala and identified harvest time as relevant to some festivals. The question about whether festival dates depend on seasons remained open. At home, look at a calendar and discuss one festival’s season, region, and usual activity together.
